description: What a delay, a condition that turns true, a function of the game, held actions, angles and sorting say (PLAN_GAMES_3.md, Phase 1)

examples.intent: A power-up that runs out, and a second one that starts the count again

input.natural_language: A star makes the hero fast for five seconds; picking up another before it runs out gives five seconds from then, not two runs that end the first early

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="star" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:prefab name="Star" tag="star" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="12x12" />
  <qg:scene name="field" width="320" height="180">
    <q:set name="fast" value="false" type="boolean" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16" speed="80">
      <qg:on-collision with="star">
        <qg:destroy target="other" />
        <q:set name="fast" value="true" />
        <!-- a second star before this runs out: the count starts again -->
        <qg:after seconds="5" name="star"><q:set name="fast" value="false" /></qg:after>
      </qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Star" x="120" y="90" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Star" x="200" y="90" />
    <qg:hud position="top-left"><qg:text value="{'FAST' if fast else ''}" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A bomb's fuse: what it hits is what was near it when it went off

input.natural_language: Dropping a bomb lights its fuse; two seconds later it bursts and breaks every crate within forty pixels of it

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="fuse" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:prefab name="Bomb" tag="bomb" sheet="tiles" frame="152" hitbox="12x12" />
  <qg:prefab name="Crate" tag="crate" sheet="tiles" frame="153" hitbox="16x16" solid="true" />
  <qg:scene name="yard" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16" speed="80" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Crate" x="100" y="90" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Crate" x="200" y="90" />
    <qg:on-input action="jump">
      <qg:spawn prefab="Bomb" at="hero" dx="16" />
      <!-- the bomb is `fresh` in the delay: the one just dropped, not the newest by then -->
      <qg:for-each tag="bomb" var="fresh">
        <qg:after seconds="2">
          <qg:burst at="fresh" />
          <qg:for-each tag="crate" var="crate">
            <q:if condition="{distance(crate, fresh) < 40}"><qg:destroy target="crate" /></q:if>
          </qg:for-each>
          <qg:destroy target="fresh" />
        </qg:after>
      </qg:for-each>
    </qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A wave beaten: the next one when the last enemy goes

input.natural_language: Enemies come in waves; when none is left the wave number goes up and the next wave comes after a breath

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="waves" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:prefab name="Drone" tag="enemy" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="12x12" ai="patrol" speed="40" health="1" />
  <qg:scene name="arena" width="320" height="180">
    <q:set name="wave" value="1" type="number" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="160" y="150" hitbox="16x16" speed="80"
                  attack-action="jump" attack-reach="20">
      <qg:on-collision with="enemy"><qg:damage target="other" /></qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Drone" x="80" y="40" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Drone" x="240" y="40" />
    <!-- read before every tick: it runs once as the last one goes, and again only after a new wave came -->
    <qg:when condition="{count('enemy') == 0}">
      <q:set name="wave" value="{wave + 1}" />
      <qg:after seconds="1.5">
        <q:loop var="i" from="1" to="{wave + 1}">
          <qg:spawn prefab="Drone" x="{40 * i}" y="40" />
        </q:loop>
      </qg:after>
    </qg:when>
    <qg:hud position="top-left"><qg:counter bind="wave" label="WAVE" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: One rule for every room: a function of the game

input.natural_language: Every room of a dungeon hurts the hero the same way: a heart less, a sound, and the end when none is left. Written once, not once a room

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="rooms" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="hearts" value="3" type="number" />
  <!-- in <q:application>: every scene has it (and the prefabs' handlers) -->
  <q:function name="hurt">
    <q:set name="hearts" value="{hearts - 1}" />
    <q:if condition="{hearts <= 0}"><qg:goto-scene name="fallen" /></q:if>
  </q:function>
  <qg:scene name="room-1" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16" speed="80">
      <qg:on-collision with="spikes" cooldown="60"><q:call function="hurt" /></qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:zone name="spikes" tag="spikes" x="160" y="80" width="16" height="16" />
    <qg:exit name="east" x="300" y="80" width="20" height="20" to="room-2" at="west" />
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="room-2" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16" speed="80">
      <qg:on-collision with="bat" cooldown="60"><q:call function="hurt" /></qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:zone name="bat" tag="bat" x="240" y="60" width="16" height="16" />
    <qg:exit name="west" x="-4" y="80" width="8" height="20" to="room-1" at="east" />
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="fallen" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:hud position="center"><qg:text value="{'FALLEN'}" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A charged shot: held longer, it flies faster

input.natural_language: Holding fire charges a shot; letting go fires it, and how long it was held says how fast it goes. Holding run makes the hero faster

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="charge" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:input action="fire" keys="J" />
  <qg:input action="run" keys="K" />
  <qg:prefab name="Shot" tag="shot" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="6x6" ai="fly" heading="right" speed="200" />
  <qg:scene name="range" width="320" height="180">
    <q:set name="charge" value="0" type="number" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="behavior" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16">
      <qg:behavior><qg:walk axis="both" speed="80" /></qg:behavior>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:on-input action="fire" on="release">
      <!-- the ticks it was held, read on the tick it is let go -->
      <q:set name="charge" value="{min(pressed_for('fire'), 60)}" />
      <qg:spawn prefab="Shot" at="hero" dx="12" />
    </qg:on-input>
    <qg:timer every="1">
      <q:if condition="{pressing('run')}"><qg:velocity target="hero" x="{hero.vx * 1.5}" /></q:if>
    </qg:timer>
    <qg:hud position="top-left"><qg:text value="{'CHARGE ' + str(charge)}" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A turret that turns to the hero, and a table of the best times

input.natural_language: A turret's picture turns to face the hero, in degrees; the three best times so far, sorted, and the time of this run in ticks

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="turret" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="best" value="[]" type="array" />
  <qg:prefab name="Turret" tag="turret" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="16x16" />
  <qg:scene name="yard" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="90" hitbox="16x16" speed="80">
      <qg:on-collision with="goal">
        <!-- the run's time, then the three best, fastest first -->
        <q:set name="best" value="{sort(best + [ticks()])[:3]}" />
        <qg:goto-scene name="yard" />
      </qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Turret" name="gun" x="200" y="90" />
    <qg:zone name="goal" tag="goal" x="300" y="80" width="20" height="20" />
    <qg:timer every="6">
      <qg:tween target="gun" property="rotation" to="{atan2(hero.y - gun.y, hero.x - gun.x)}" seconds="0.1" />
    </qg:timer>
    <!-- a mark that circles the turret: cos and sin of degrees -->
    <qg:timer every="2">
      <qg:put target="mark" x="{gun.x + 30 * cos(ticks() * 3)}" y="{gun.y + 30 * sin(ticks() * 3)}" />
    </qg:timer>
    <qg:instance prefab="Turret" name="mark" x="230" y="90" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
